photos.c: Below: Du'aine Ladejo, Matt Douglas, Geoff Dearman and Sean Baldock (still breathing hard after his last leg stint) enjoy the attention after providing the most dominating display of the evening. It was Du'aine's last race before signing for Birchfield Harriers.

Bottom right: Last leg of the last race of the day and Sean Baldock clinches another great team win.
